result.independent_corroboration: ABC/independent result reporting agrees with Panthers 19-12 Roosters
result.source_conflict: A News.com.au live report exposed 17-12 in one version. That conflicts with the official NRL full-time score and independent 19-12 reporting and is retained as a stale-source conflict, not used as the canonical result.

tip_grade.freeze_integrity: No T-10 probability or evidence state is reconstructed after kickoff.

weather_audit.pre_match_state: Dry CommBank Stadium match window with benign-to-moderate wind context.

evidence_family_independence: Market, season structure, recent scoring, official roster/role changes, player statistical dossiers, prior same-venue matchup evidence and weather were treated as separate evidence families; market was not counted as independent corroboration.
adversarial_counter_case: The Roosters had beaten Penrith 12-6 at CommBank Stadium in Round 24, retained a senior Tedesco-Cherry-Evans-Robson-Radley core, and Penrith entered the final after a late positional reshuffle. This remained the strongest supported case against Penrith.
falsification_state: The Panthers edge would have required further reduction or switch if late evidence materially weakened Penrith spine/middle continuity, strengthened the Roosters continuity edge, or reliable market movement pushed the normalized Penrith probability far enough below MAYHEM without independent football evidence.

post_kickoff_observations.observation: Nathan Cleary was sin-binned late in the first half. Penrith began the second half with 12 men, but the Roosters did not score during the one-man advantage.
Nathan Cleary kicked the go-ahead field goal in the 72nd minute for a 13-12 Penrith lead.
Brian To'o scored in the 78th minute and Dylan Edwards converted, producing the official final score Panthers 19-12 Roosters.
Egan Butcher failed an HIA; Salesi Foketi later left for an HIA. These events occurred after kickoff and cannot be used to justify the pre-match selection retrospectively.

team_macro_effects.Panthers: Verified finals win after surviving a second-half period without Cleary and reversing the Round 24 same-venue loss. Add as a longitudinal finals-performance observation without overwriting pre-match state.
team_macro_effects.Roosters: Verified 19-12 qualifying-final loss after leading 12-6 and entering halftime 12-12. They move to a sudden-death Week 2 final against the Sharks. Add as a longitudinal finals-performance observation without treating in-match HIA events as pre-match defects.

player_effects.Nathan Cleary: Post-kickoff: sin-bin, returned with score still level, kicked 72nd-minute field goal; reported late leg issue is post-match medical/availability evidence only and requires future official verification before any Week 3 role inference.
player_effects.Brian To'o: Post-kickoff: late try extended Penrith beyond a converted-try margin.
player_effects.Dylan Edwards: Post-kickoff: first-half try and late conversion recorded in official match chronology.
player_effects.Egan Butcher: Post-kickoff: failed HIA; no hidden medical inference.
player_effects.Salesi Foketi: Post-kickoff: left for HIA; no hidden medical inference.

matchup_memory_update: Penrith lost 6-12 to the Roosters at CommBank Stadium in Round 24, then won the qualifying final 19-12 at the same venue. Preserve both observations; do not reduce the relationship to a single directional matchup rule.

calibration.reason: T-10m was MISSED_NOT_CAPTURED and no contemporaneous T-10 frozen probability exists.
calibration.integrity: No probability is backfilled after the result. This internal metadata does not qualify the public CORRECT grade.

information_advantage.reason: The correct result alone does not prove information advantage. MAYHEM 72% was close to the last reliable normalized market probability and no independently demonstrated pre-market causal signal was validated by the outcome.

learning.validated_carry_forward: Continue the previously audited switch-or-reduce test when current form, restored-unit continuity, matchup evidence and role-critical statistical production converge against the preferred side.

next_fixture_candidate.basis: Official NRL post-match report states the Roosters will host the Sharks in a sudden-death final next Saturday night.
